A '''Human female''' with [[Color/Legends|brown]] hair was a member of the [[Imperial Knight]]s in [[137 ABY]]. [[Gender/Legends|She]] was one of many Knights who served as a [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] to [[Roan Fel]], [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] of the [[Empire-in-exile]], as he traveled to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]] to conduct [[Mission to Agamar|peace talks]] with members of the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]]. Everyone present disguised themselves as [[Farm/Legends|farmers]] during the negotiations, and the brown-haired female joined several other Knights in pretending to tend to a field close to the talks. All disguises were shed when a [[One Sith|Sith]] strike force attacked, and a [[Operation: Thunderstroke|skirmish]] ensued in which the brown-haired female fought. Most of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and Imperial Knights, including the Emperor, escaped from the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] and fled the planet.

==Biography==
In [[137 ABY]], a [[Color/Legends|brown]]-haired [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] served as a member of the [[Imperial Knight]]s,<ref name="Legacy 46" /> an order of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-users]] who had pledged loyalty to [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]] and his [[Empire-in-exile]].<ref name="LECG">''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref> In that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], a large group of Knights that included the brown-haired female served as [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]] to Fel as he traveled to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]]. The Emperor was [[Mission to Agamar|rendezvousing]] on the planet's surface with representatives of the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]]; the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and Fel had a common enemy in [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]], and both parties hoped to forge an alliance directed against [[Darth Krayt|Krayt's]] forces.<ref name="Legacy 46" /><ref name="Legacy 45">[[Legacy (2006) 45|''Legacy'' (2006) 45]]</ref>

On the morning of the peace talks, every Jedi and Imperial Knight disguised themselves as [[Agamarian]] [[Farm/Legends|farmers]], and the brown-haired female joined several other Knights in pretending to tend to a field near to the negotiations. While they exercised their deception,<ref name="Legacy 46" /> Fel and several Imperial Knight Masters met with four Jedi representatives, led by the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[K'Kruhk]]. An agreement was reached, but the meeting was interrupted immediately thereafter by [[Morrigan Corde|Nyna Calixte]]&mdash;the [[Director of Imperial Intelligence]] for Krayt's Empire&mdash;who was secretly aiding Fel. She rode a [[Agamarian beast|local beast]] into the field where the brown-haired female was stationed, but after two Imperial Knights fired [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]] at the animal, she collapsed onto the ground. Calixte hurriedly told the two groups that Krayt's [[One Sith|Sith]] were aware of their meeting and had sent a [[First Sith Imperial Strikeforce|task force]] to capture or [[Death/Legends|kill]] the Emperor.<ref name="Legacy 45" />

A [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] strike team then rose from some nearby swamps, and [[Antares Draco]],<ref name="Legacy 46" /> the leader of the Imperial Knights,<ref name="LECG" /> called on his Knights to defend the Emperor. All farmer disguises were jettisoned, and the brown-haired female ignited her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] as the [[Operation: Thunderstroke|battle]] began. The Jedi joined their new allies in fighting off the attacking Sith and protecting the Emperor, and the combat saw at least ten Sith fall to the blades of Jedi and Imperial Knights, as well as to Calixte's [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]].<ref name="Legacy 46" /> Some Jedi and Imperial Knights were slain as well,<ref name="Legacy 48">[[Legacy (2006) 48|''Legacy'' (2006) 48]]</ref> but most of the survivors, including the Emperor, managed to evacuate the fray on the escape [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] ''[[Defender One]]''.<ref name="Legacy 46" />

==Powers and abilities==
The brown-haired female was a member of the Imperial Knights,<ref name="Legacy 46" /> an organization that was dedicated to protecting the Emperor and preserving his Empire. They were considered to be among the most dangerous and talented [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-users in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="LECG" />

==Equipment==
The woman wore [[Imperial Knight armor]] and used the order's [[Imperial Knight lightsaber|standard lightsaber]]. On Agamar, the Imperial Knight donned farmer's robes.<ref name="Legacy 46" /> 

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial Knight was created by [[John Ostrander]] and [[Jan Duursema]] for the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]'', and first appeared in its [[Legacy (2006) 45|forty-fifth issue]],<ref name="Legacy 45" /> which was released on [[February 24]], [[2010]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54417/star_wars_legacy_2006_45|text=Star Wars: Legacy (2006) #45}}</ref>
